root_idea.summary: The contracted root points chiefly to two orientations: slight moisture or residual water, and sound. Its reduplicated forms especially convey repeated, resonant, or crackling sound.
root_idea.development: The moisture branch includes moist earth, remnants of water, scattered rain, and herbage named after rain; the sound branch extends from ringing objects to dry earth and clay that produces a sound. Other lexical developments include alteration or spoilage and figurative force.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic nominal is presented under its normalized Classical Arabic citation form.

senses.definition: 1. Dry clay that makes a ringing or crackling sound, especially clay not yet baked into pottery.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic descriptions of the material from which the human being was created. The sound is associated with the clay's dryness or composition with sand.

senses.definition: 2. Clay understood as black mud altered in odor.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation of the Quranic clay passages; it is an exegetical interpretation distinct from the sound-based description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sound, ring, or emit a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of iron, nails, helmets, jars, bits, ornaments, dry things, and thunder; repeated or more emphatic sound is expressed by related reduplicated forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a rumbling or crackling sound associated with thirst or dryness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of the belly of a thirsty person or animal, of a dried water-skin, and of the sound made as water enters the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become stinking or altered for the worse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of flesh and of water, the latter becoming worse in taste and color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dried up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a reported alternative reading of Quran 32:9; the reading and interpretation are distinct from the ordinary reading of that verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To befall as a calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction صَلَّتْهُمُ الصَّالَّةُ, ‘the calamity befell them.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clear or separate a drink or material from impurities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of clearing wine or another beverage, and of separating grain from earth by washing it with water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put skin or a lining onto a boot or another object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived form denotes applying a piece of skin or an inner lining, especially to footwear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To threaten, menace, frighten, or terrify.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the reduplicated verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slay the chief man of an army.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use reported for the reduplicated verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter a word or sentence with a show of verbal skill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes affected or ostentatiously skilful formulation of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dry and crackling, said of the black mud in a pool left by a torrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sound is presented as a consequence of the mud's drying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Altered or spoiled flesh-meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of meat that has deteriorated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A serpent, especially one regarded as deadly or resistant to charming.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some descriptions specify a yellow serpent found in sand or one whose bite kills immediately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cunning, crafty, and abominable person likened to a serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively, especially of a person formidable in contention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sharp sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the serpent term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An equal, counterpart, or match.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions comparing one person or thing with another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain plant or species of tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal plant meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A forceful ringing sound, especially that of a nail or bit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the sound produced when an object is struck forcefully.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dry ground or land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Definitions vary as to the precise relation of the dry tract to neighboring areas; the term is associated with ground that makes a sound when trodden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sole of a boot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sole is named by association with dry ground and the sound of treading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Skin, especially dry or untanned skin; also stinking skin in the tan.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in descriptions of the skin or covering of a boot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain, either extensive and abundant or scattered and scanty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records both opposing quantities; scattered portions of rain are also called صِلَالٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion or scattered growth of herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The herbage is named after the rain associated with it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Moist earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate earth-related nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remnant of water in a watering-trough, or of oil and similar liquids.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to what remains after the greater part of a liquid has been taken or used.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fetid odor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal odor-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The flabbiness of moist flesh-meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive nominal use for soft, slack flesh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A very cunning person in whom there is no good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression هُوَ تِبْعُ صِلَّةٍ, with variant vocalization reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The leg of a boot, or its lining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources distinguish the boot leg from the lining as variant related uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clay that makes a sound like new pottery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective or substantivized adjective for resonant clay.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose belly makes a rumbling sound from thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water altered for the worse in taste and color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal or adjectival description of deteriorated water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain herb or leguminous plant used as pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plant is described as a durable, valuable kind of herbage and as camel fodder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water that falls on the ground, which then dries or cracks and makes a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized participial description of the audible effect of drying ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stinking or altered in odor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Derived by association with the verb used of deteriorated flesh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small bird, including a pigeon or a female pigeon; also identified with a collared turtle-dove in some descriptions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptions vary among a small bird, a pigeon, and a bird resembling the collared turtle-dove.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forelock or a white marking in a horse's mane, including whitened hair on the back or breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact marking varies in the lexical descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A drinking-cup or bowl, especially a small one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the vessel called غُمَر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skilful pastor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized personal-description noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remaining portion of water or oil in a pool, vessel, or skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of liquid left in a torrent pool or container after the greater part has gone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hair collected on the head or hanging down around the ears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A synonymic hair-related use with several traditional descriptions of length and arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A noisy or strong-voiced ass, wild ass, or horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes an animal vehement or sharp in its braying, neighing, or other voice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A land in which there is no one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate place noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel in which wine or another beverage is cleared.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal term associated with Yemen in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Copious or abundant rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive nominal or adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A generous, noble, honorable chief of pure parentage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person characterized by nobility, generosity, honor, and purity of lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A maker of boots or footwear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational use.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Inflectional or place-noun classification attached to a pointer.
A possible epithet is reported but may be a scribal mistake.

cautions: The second Quranic sense records a reported interpretation of صَلْصَالٌ as odor-altered black mud; it should not be treated as the only meaning of the Quranic noun.
The Lane material includes variant readings and competing lexical explanations, especially for the verb صَلَّ and for several Classical nominal forms.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:SlSl:26323:g1:sub2 reports مُصَلْصَلٌ as a possible epithet only if it is not a scribal mistake; the uncertain attribution is not assigned to a public meaning.
